prompts.name: 01-result
prompts.prompt: Edit this actual MindCraft screenshot into a polished submission gallery image, NOT a redesigned UI. Absolutely preserve the complete screenshot's original Korean text, colors, proportions, controls, and data; no invented product UI or text changes inside screenshot. Expand canvas above by 160px and below by 100px in deep aubergine #251c3a. Original screenshot remains full visible and readable in center. Top left white bold Korean headline exactly '자료와 결과, 한눈에'. Smaller line exactly '어떤 자료로 만든 결과인지 함께 확인합니다.' Top right tiny brand 'MindCraft'. Add ONLY two thin purple rectangular outlines around the existing result document area center-left and the existing source-card list on right, with small numbered circles 1 and 2 at upper edges, covering no important text. Bottom legend in white: '1 결과 문서 읽기    2 선택한 자료와 출처 확인'. Bottom secondary footnote '실제 GUI 캡처 기반 · 설명 강조 편집 · 오프라인 샘플 · 모델 호출 없음'. No extra illustrations. Crisp Korean typography. Keep the UI screenshot intact, do not redraw or reinterpret it. Return one finished landscape gallery image.

prompts.prompt: Edit FIRST image, an actual MindCraft screenshot, into submission gallery image. SECOND image is layout/style reference only. Match second image's dark aubergine header/footer, purple thin highlight rectangles with numbered circles, bold white Korean headline, overall 1536x1024 landscape composition. Crucial: preserve FIRST screenshot original controls, content, colors, Korean text and proportions as faithfully as possible. Do not invent, add, remove or redesign product UI. Fit full screenshot inside central image frame with top headline band and bottom caption band. No added illustrations. Top headline exactly '첫 작업은 가볍게'. Subtitle exactly '하고 싶은 일을 적거나, 샘플부터 시작하세요.'. Brand 'MindCraft' small top right. Add thin purple rectangular highlight outlines around these existing areas only, numbered sequentially: main central request input box, and bottom wide sample project starter card. Put numbered legend in footer exactly '1 원하는 일 입력    2 샘플로 먼저 체험'. Footnote exactly '실제 GUI 캡처 기반 · 설명 강조 편집 · 오프라인 샘플 · 모델 호출 없음'. For model settings picture also include small text '설정 화면 · 실제 연결 성공이나 절감 실측 아님'. Clear readable typography, callouts don't cover important existing UI text. Keep colors consistent with second style image.
